# Server Actions

Server actions are action blocks that allows the bot to perform server related actions that affect a server member or manage the server.

| Block                                                                                                        | Information                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [Kick a member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/kick-a-member.md)                         | This block will kick a specified member from a server.                                                                                     |
| [Ban a member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/ban-a-member.md)                           | This block will ban a specified member from a server.                                                                                      |
| [Timeout a member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/timeout-a-member.md)                   | This block will timeout a specified member from a server.                                                                                  |
| [Change a members nickname](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/change-a-members-nickname.md) | With this block you are able to change a server members' nickname.                                                                         |
| [Purge messages](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/purge-messages.md)                       | This block allows you to purge a specific amount of messages in a specific channel.                                                        |
| [Leave Server](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/leave-server.md)                           | With this action, you can make the bot to leave a server.                                                                                  |
| [Create Server Invite](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/server-actions/create-server-invite.md)           | This block will create a server invite for a specific server that can be created to have many specifications, such as uses, duration, etc. |
